summary: Backend-only testing of News-Blackout filter feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_news_blackout.py with 19 tests covering: ForexFactory calendar feed (/api/calendar/events structure + filters + only_scheduled), /api/calendar/blackout (structure, next_event.minutes_until, window validation), /api/analysis/ai news_blackout payload (filter off → {filter_enabled:false,in_blackout:false}; filter on → full status echo with window_minutes), cache key separation by both nb<0|1> and bw<N> flags, AISignal serialization with the new Optional[Dict] news_blackout field, and full regression on /api/market/quote, /api/market/candles, /api/analysis/indicators, /api/signals/history, /api/signals/stats, /api/news, /api/ea/signal, /api/ea/download. Combined run with prior test_xauusd_api.py: 27 passed in 4.55s. The override path was successfully exercised live at blackout_window=120 — FOMC speaker event matched _is_gold_sensitive via title keyword, original rule action=SELL was correctly overridden to action=HOLD with confidence halved (88→44), summary prefixed 'BLACKOUT —', and news_blackout.overridden_from='SELL'. Behavior matches spec exactly.

minor.issue: The review request spec mentions blackout_window=240/1440 as the 'wide window to catch an event' test, but the endpoint enforces ge=0,le=120 on blackout_window (line 942 in server.py). Sending 240 returns HTTP 422. This is a spec/implementation mismatch — either the doc/test plan should say le=120, or the bound should be raised (e.g., le=480 or le=1440) so override-path testing is reliably reproducible regardless of when in the week the test runs. We worked around by using 120 (which happened to catch an FOMC speaker event).

Some entries in the upstream feed have impact='Holiday' which is not in the documented 'Low|Medium|High' enum. Not a bug — just permissive — but worth either documenting the extra value or normalizing it server-side.
(carried from iteration 1+2) TwelveData 429 still leaks as HTTP 500 with no Retry-After. Not exercised in this run but remains a latent UX issue during free-tier quota windows.

action_items: (Minor) Raise upper bound on `blackout_window` Query param from le=120 to le=480 (or 1440) so QA / users can preview override behavior outside ±2h. Current bound makes the override path non-deterministically testable.
(Optional, low) Document or normalize the extra 'Holiday' value for ForexFactory event `impact` field — the API currently passes it through verbatim.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:944 — cache_key f'ai:{engine}:au{int(auto_upgrade)}:nb{int(news_blackout)}:bw{blackout_window}:{interval}' correctly includes both nb and bw → no cache bleed between (off↔on) and across different blackout_window values. Verified empirically (different `id` per slot).

server.py:1090-1117 — News-blackout override logic is sound: only fires when filter_enabled AND in_blackout AND action ∈ {BUY,SELL}; confidence floor (max 20, half of original) prevents accidental zero; summary is prefixed 'BLACKOUT — ' and embeds event title + minutes_until; original reasoning is preserved (appended after the blackout explanation). Override path observed live during test.

server.py:1593-1598 — _is_gold_sensitive() correctly handles both (a) USD High-impact and (b) USD events whose title matches HIGH_PRIORITY_TITLES (FOMC/NFP/CPI etc.) even when upstream impact is 'Low' (FOMC speaker case verified live).

server.py:1538-1591 — ForexFactory fetch has 30-min cache + stale fallback on network error; ET→UTC conversion via ZoneInfo is correct; non-scheduled labels ('All Day', 'Tentative', '') are parsed to when_utc=None with scheduled=False as documented.
server.py:1654 — /api/calendar/blackout enforces window_minutes ge=0,le=120. Same bound on /api/analysis/ai blackout_window — see action item.
server.py:319 — AISignal model: `news_blackout: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None` is the right shape; both off-mode (small dict) and on-mode (full status dict) serialize without 500.
server.py:1099-1115 — minutes_until phrasing handles past/future/now correctly ('in N min', 'N min ago', 'now') and uses abs() so the readable message never goes negative — good UX touch.
server.py overall — file now 2083 lines; calendar/blackout block (~150 lines) is self-contained and could move to a `backend/services/calendar.py` module on next refactor pass.
seed_data_creation: Multiple AI signals inserted into ai_signals collection with the new news_blackout field populated (both filter-off and filter-on variants, including one override BLACKOUT signal where overridden_from='SELL'). ForexFactory weekly XML cached in backend in-memory cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: blackout_window upper bound is 120 (not 240/1440 as the original spec suggested). At the time of this test, the override path was reachable at blackout_window=120 because an FOMC speaker event was within ±120min (matched via title keyword). On a different day this may not be the case — if test_filter_on_max_window_override_path skips/fails, that's expected (no event in window), not a regression. Cache TTLs unchanged: 60s rule / 180s ai. Cache key format: 'ai:{engine}:au{0|1}:nb{0|1}:bw{N}:{interval}'. ForexFactory feed cached 30 min with stale fallback. Frontend (Dashboard.jsx, AISignalCard.jsx, api.js) not tested.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in the targeted News-Blackout feature. All spec requirements validated: (1) calendar feed structure + filters work; (2) blackout endpoint returns correct shape with valid minutes_until; (3) AI endpoint payload differs correctly between filter off/on; (4) override fires correctly (HOLD, halved confidence, BLACKOUT summary, overridden_from set) when in_blackout=True AND rule action ∈ {BUY,SELL}; (5) cache key separation by nb and bw verified via distinct response IDs; (6) AISignal model serializes news_blackout field without 500; (7) all regression endpoints healthy. The only minor finding is the spec↔code discrepancy on blackout_window upper bound (120 vs 240/1440).
